names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Βίκτωρ ο Ιερομάρτυρας Επίσκοπος Γκλαζώφ», with the rank words and the see left off; the page gives his name in the world as Constantine Alexandrovich Ostrovidov, in Greek letters.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 9139, «Святитель Виктор (Островидов), епископ Глазовский, исп.», with the rank words and the see left off; the see stays in this folder’s `office` and display name. The life gives his name in the world as «Константин Александрович Островидов», the monastic name being taken at the Kazan academy.

birth.note: saint.gr: «γεννήθηκε στις 20 Μαΐου του 1875 μ.Χ. στο χωριό Ζολοτόε της περιφέρειας Σαρατόβσκαγια».

death.note: saint.gr: «Κοιμήθηκε το έτος 1934 μ.Χ. από πνευμονία», and the page heads him «(1875 - 1934)».

feast.note: His life page heads «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 19 апреля , 8 июня (Петерб.) , 18 июня (обретение мощей)» and keeps four days. This row stands on 19 апреля, the day whose page listed him and the day of his repose, which is the day the `greek` row already carries. One row per church is the schema, so the synaxis of the new martyrs, the synaxis of the saints of Petersburg and the finding of his relics are recorded here and he does not render on them; none of those three day pages was read.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 апреля ст. ст. — «Свт. Виктора исп., еп. Глазовского (1934).»

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with saint.gr in both years, 1875 and 1934, and in the cause of death, so nothing in `dates` was changed; it supplies the day, 19 апреля, which the Greek page did not. The glorification of August 2000 and the «26 января (Новомуч.)» on his life page are what `new-martyr` stands on. The day page prints no hymn under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Βίκτωρ ο Ιερομάρτυρας Επίσκοπος Γκλαζώφ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page is a full life and a dated one: born 20 May 1875 at the village of Zolotoye in the Saratov region, a doctor of theology from the academy of Kazan in 1903, bishop of Urzhum and vicar of the Vyatka diocese in January 1920, bishop of Glazov from 1924, arrested in 1919, 1922, 1926 and 1928, in the camp on Solovki, exiled to the Komi country in 1932, and dead of pneumonia in 1934 in the village of Neritsa; his relics found incorrupt there on 18 June 1997 and translated to a convent at Vyatka on 2 December 1997. It calls him Ιερομάρτυρας although the death it records is by illness in exile, and that is the page's own word. It prints no hymn. The three folders the corpus already keeps for a new-martyr Victor are presbyters, not this bishop.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
